title: Dream locations: a partial explanation?
content: TL;DR some mall worlds are maybe dream realities created by people close to us who've died, and we're visiting them. A long time ago I worked at a company and we were like a family. All very close etc. Eventually the company closed down and we all moved on, some people since have passed away. Then a few years ago I started having recurring dreams about working there. Like, sure I missed the place a little, but enough to start having recurring dreams? It didn't seem likely. The dreams were just me working and one dream was even me sat in a meeting for hours. At first I thought it might be some kind of parallel universe bleed through, an alternative universe me still works there and I was somehow tapping into that, but that didn't make sense because everyone was the same as they were years ago, there was no new people (in some dreams there would sometimes be new people) but for the most part it was all the same, but for sure people would have left, retired or died etc. Then last night I had another dream and I had a realization. In this dream I worked for the same company but we'd lost the contract I handled, so I was in a truck, we arrived at a depot and I was told the 'vibes were off', dream me was also ripped. I went into this depot and there was a brand new vending machine to the side, and the back was also covered in a black fog, with a mirror that was upside down (not sure if the mirror or the reflections in the mirror were upside down) but it was weird. I met two girls I used to work with, and I remember thinking I hadn't seen them forever even though we worked for the same company, then I picked up a lot of paperwork to help out with, and that was pretty much the dream. But then I realized that the common denominator between these dreams was my old boss, and the recurring dreams started after he died. In some [belief systems](https://www.amazon.com/Sleeping-Dreaming-Dying-Exploration-Consciousness/dp/0861711238), when you die if you don't accept it or are confused you create a reality where you live out your previous life, and that continues until you sort of 'wake up' to the fact you're actually dead, in these realities weird things keep happening to prompt you wake up and realize you're dead. So my theory is, my boss died and is living in some kind of world centered around our old company, and I'm visiting him which explains my recurring dreams. This raises more questions than answers though, are other people visiting him as well? Or just me? Why just me? (it could be to do with awareness/mediation etc) I've lost contact with most everyone from that time, so it's not like I could ask them if they're having the dreams too. But my idea is that the mall worlds/dream locations are maybe dream worlds created by people close to us who have died, and we're visiting. This would only explain a small portion of experiences though.
